title: feat: add Decider V1.1 27B for typed decisions
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added Perplexity’s `perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` for paid-balance, text-only decisions: typed choices, scores and yes/no probabilities across a 262,144-token context. Send state and questions to `/alpha/decisions`, or put the same JSON in the last user message on `/v1/chat/completions`. Pricing is per 1M input tokens. Vercel AI Gateway is the primary route, with a hidden OpenRouter fallback for gateway failures; both routes use Perplexity’s backend. Narrowed the catalog test guard to Sonar models so decision models can use the `perplexity/` prefix.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workshop, Polli wears tiny decision-maker glasses and sorts glowing lime green (#ecf874) choice cards marked YES and NO beside a retro terminal and flowering code-plants. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream backdrop and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
